about: Freeze 46 (plan version 49), block G: RabbitMQ's credit, certified at a bound of 50 ms. Run with RATE=2000 DURATION=70 WARMUP_S=20 PRIME_S=60. Every run sends Poisson, runs its load at 70% in 5-s blocks, on then off, at the duty version 47's pilot froze for its setup; takes both client captures, the card's and the broker's; runs the producer at real-time priority with the clients' collectors off; records its facts and each broker's image digest and version; and is held to the lateness rule (docs/results/general_method/DESIGN49.md). Each setup is version 47's judged setup of the same settings, under this version's id. Queue: python3 scripts/run_queue.py make, once for each round, from this design with rounds 1 and first_round 1 to 6, joined in that order into runs/azure/queues/g49g.csv: a single setup has no order to shuffle
